LanguageData.HE_Albion_Shako.label: shako
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Shako.description: A tall stiff cap with a brass plate and a short plume. It makes a soldier look half a head taller.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Redcoat.label: redcoat
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Redcoat.description: A red wool coat with white facings, brass buttons and crossed white belts. Warm, sturdy and impossible to miss.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FrockCoat.label: frock coat
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FrockCoat.description: A knee-length black wool coat with tails, silk lapels and brass buttons. Bankers, engineers and members of parliament all wear one.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_TopHat.label: top hat
LanguageData.HE_Albion_TopHat.description: A tall hat of black silk plush. It adds a head of height and a great deal of respectability.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Bicorne.label: bicorne
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Bicorne.description: A two-cornered officer's hat trimmed with gold lace and the national cockade. Admirals and generals wear it sideways; everyone salutes.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_RifleGreen.label: rifle green jacket
LanguageData.HE_Albion_RifleGreen.description: The dark green of the rifle regiments, with black facings, black buttons and a cross belt. It hides in a hedge; it is meant to.
